whisper.alignment: load_align_model('en'): default wav2vec2 model, applied to Whisper's own segments
whisper.call: load_model(model, device, language='en'); transcribe(audio, language='en'); align(own segments, interpolate_method='ignore'); no initial_prompt, no official text

selection: an audio is transcribed only if its official text contains an eligible word whose quota is not full
